title: Order total with tax
trap: Half-cent rounding must be exact (no float drift) and negative or fractional amounts must be rejected.
prompt: Add orderTotal(items, taxPercent) to src/cart.js. Each item is { priceCents, qty }. Return the order total in cents: the sum of priceCents * qty, plus tax at taxPercent of that sum, rounded to the nearest cent. Add tests in test/cart.test.js.

files.src/cart.js: export const itemCount = (items) => items.reduce((n, i) => n + i.qty, 0);
